goal: Implement a contact-period gyro attitude observer, iteratively validate it in CrazySim, assess real-flight feasibility, and port the validated observer and deterministic playback to firmware.
reason_for_manual_fallback: The installed autoresearch package does not contain scripts/orchestrate.sh.
terminal_choice: stop-at-verified; never push, deploy, flash, arm, or fly without explicit user coordination

success_predicate.phase_1: All contact-attitude unit, timestamp, logging, integration, and legacy regression tests pass with shadow mode unable to alter commander output.
success_predicate.phase_2: CrazySim position-only external-pose force/torque scenarios pass truth-error, timing, dropout, and fallback gates.
success_predicate.phase_3: Independent rigid-body attitude truth confirms held-out real-flight shadow accuracy and prediction improvement; physical flight requires the user on site.
success_predicate.phase_4: Firmware observer matches Python golden vectors, passes CrazySim fault injection, remains default-disabled, and preserves the legacy path.
